snippet.title: Black Friday Janitor: Clean the Whole Mall - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Black Friday Janitor: Clean the Whole Mall hands you the biggest clean-up job of the year! Over 30,000 items to clean, with dozens of unique stores across a huge, once-beautiful mall! Organize products, pick up trash, clean stains, to return the mall to its former glory! Improve your cleaning skills to learn new tricks. And remember, it's a big job, so don't expect to finish it all in one go!

Releasing 9th September on Steam
